grammar.title: Scope and focus through word order
grammar.explain: In Telugu, this lesson uses quotative అని, converbs, participial relatives, case suffixes, inclusive/exclusive person reference, honorific plural and diglossic literary–colloquial choices. At C2, form and word order encode stance, information structure, social distance, and textual cohesion rather than merely tense. Compare the target model with an unqualified literal assertion and preserve its scope in mediation.
